_comment: SOLE signer-verifier allowlist for asymmetric (Ed25519) capability leases — Foundation C rev4 (ASYMMETRIC-LEASE-AUTHORITY-DESIGN-20260806.md). Public-only; NO private material. Consumers (C2 issuer, C2 enforcement) verify signed leases against this file via capability_lease.verify_authoritative(). key_id is a REQUIRED signed field on every ed25519 lease; a key entry not present here, or present with status != "active", denies at verify time (re-checked every call). This placeholder public key is NOT paired with any provisioned private key — the confined lease-signing-authority service (a later, not-yet-built slice) is the only intended holder of the matching private key, provisioned via SOPS. Default-OFF: CAPABILITY_ASYMMETRIC_LEASE=0 means no ed25519 lease is minted or expected yet.
